item.title: Nepal: Former Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli, ex-home minister arrested over Gen Z protest crackdown
item.description: Former Nepal Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli and Home Minister Ramesh Lekhak were arrested in a culpable homicide case linked to the September Gen Z protests. Police acted on a commission's report recommending charges for criminal negligence, which resulted in 77 deaths and significant property damage. The arrests follow the swearing-in of new Prime Minister Balendra Shah.

item.title: Gates adviser served as conduit to Epstein, discussed ‘hot girls’
item.description: The emails, part of a trove of justice department records, suggest Nikolic, who worked at Gates’ venture firm, acted as Gates’ proxy, often coordinating meetups between the Microsoft Corp co-founder and Epstein, and occasionally discussing Epstein’s potential to connect Gates with companions. item.title: Mum who vanished without trace in 2001 found alive, meets daughter in emotional courthouse reunion
item.description: After vanishing without a trace in 2001, a North Carolina mother has been found alive 24 years later, bringing a long-running missing-person case to a startling close. Her reappearance has led to an emotional reunion with her daughter, while exposing deep family tensions and unanswered questions about why she left and where she had been for decades.

item.title: Clavicular arrest update: Florida streamer allegedly instigated fight between women on stream
item.description: Looksmaxxing streamer Clavicular, real name Braden Eric Peters, is jailed in Florida for allegedly inciting a fight between two women at an Airbnb. Police claim he provoked the altercation for social media views, leading to misdemeanor battery and criminal conspiracy charges. His alleged girlfriend, Violet Marie Lentz, also faces battery charges and remains at large.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Invisible buildings: Why Switzerland marks out homes with tall poles weeks before construction
item.description: Switzerland unveils a unique construction practice where empty frameworks, called Bauprofile, map future buildings with poles and lines. This allows residents to visualize and challenge developments before construction, fostering transparency and public participation in urban planning. The system ensures informed objections by presenting proposals at full scale, bridging the gap between abstract plans and tangible reality.

item.title: 8 sky events in April 2026 you can’t miss: From a blazing comet to meteor storms
item.description: If you are into watching the stars, April 2026 will be an exciting month for you! It includes an amazing experience for all to see: the arrival of a 'Celestial Theatre,' including Comet C/2026 A1 (MAPS) from deep space; an event such as the Lyrid meteor shower from the Earth; and being able to observe a Planet Parade high above Earth (which will occur two hours before sunrise). The highlight will be on April 4, when Comet C/2026 A1 (MAPS) will make its close approach to our sun and may shine bright enough in the morning sky. All in all, if you are tracking the Pink Moon or catching the 2,700-year-old Lyrid meteor showers, April has at least 8 different ways to watch the universe in action.

item.title: Ice Poseidon slams stream clippers as ‘leeches’, refuses to pay $400K for clips
item.description: Kick streamer Ice Poseidon ignited a debate by criticizing 'clippers' who profit from short stream highlights. He argued streamers are the true creators and rejected exorbitant payments for clip creation, fearing it stifles originality. Poseidon believes some creators rely too heavily on clips, impacting genuine content. His stance has divided online opinions.

item.title: From Kharg to Qeshm: 6 Iranian Islands Trump may target amid Strait of Hormuz tensions
item.description: The US is reportedly considering military options against Iran, focusing on key Persian Gulf islands vital for oil exports and naval control. Plans reportedly include ground and bombing operations, with potential targets like Kharg Island, a major oil hub, and Larak Island, crucial for Strait of Hormuz monitoring. Seizing these locations presents significant risks.

item.title: US State Department issues list of world’s most dangerous countries for Americans amid Iran conflict
item.description: The US has updated global travel advisories as tensions involving Iran heighten security risks worldwide. Several countries, including Iran, remain at the highest “Do Not Travel” level, while caution levels have risen across parts of the Middle East. Officials warn of threats ranging from detention to violence, urging Americans to stay vigilant and monitor conditions closely.

item.title: Clavicular mugshot leaks after Fort Lauderdale arrest as Violet and Jenny Popach fight link raises questions
item.description: Braden “Clavicular” was arrested in Fort Lauderdale on March 26, 2026, with a battery-related charge. His mugshot quickly went viral online. Reports suggest the arrest may be linked to a past altercation involving his girlfriend Violet and influencer Jenny Popach. Adin Ross stated the arrest was not related to a viral alligator video. Further updates are awaited.
